name: Mercy (Lambda-class)
description: Mercy was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in service to the Rebel Alliance. The shuttle was used in a rescue operation near Stars' End to board the BFF-1 bulk freighter Hampton and rescue two Rebel pilots, while two Alliance-flown Y-wings held off the escort frigate Furious attacks long enough for the Mercy to rescue the two pilots and escape into hyperspace.
